name: Seeker of Slaanesh
oracle_text:
Haste
Allure of Slaanesh — Each opponent must attack with at least one creature each combat if able.
blocked_sentences: Allure of Slaanesh — Each opponent must attack with at least one creature each combat if able.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "opponent") imposing a per-player attack requirement: during each combat in which an affected player is the active player, their attack declaration must include at least one creature if any creature they control could legally attack (508.1d, maximizing requirements obeyed), without forcing any particular creature to attack
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The attacks_if_able static (and the must_attack op) put the requirement on each creature its affects filter matches, so affects {controller: opponent} would force EVERY opponent creature to attack rather than at least one; goaded and must_attack_player are also per-creature. Nothing in static_effects places an attack requirement on a player rather than on objects
